p2.a7.encounter.title: Floor 1 · Sentinel Crosswind Ridge
p2.a7.encounter.setup: Calibrated ridge sentinels sweep the stone narrows with acoustic chimes and light arcs before resetting their posture.
p2.a7.encounter.b1.prompt: At the first basalt narrows, a ridge sentinel sweeps the lane on a two-chime cycle.
p2.a7.encounter.b1.clue1: Every second chime leaves a 2.5-second blind arc along the leeward parapet.
p2.a7.encounter.b1.clue2: The sentinel's shoulder latch uncouples briefly right after its sweep finishes.
p2.a7.encounter.b1.opt1.label: Slip along the leeward parapet on the second chime
p2.a7.encounter.b1.opt1.outcome: You clear the narrows untouched while keeping your breathing steady.
p2.a7.encounter.b1.opt2.label: Strike the uncoupled shoulder latch during the post-sweep pause
p2.a7.encounter.b1.opt2.outcome: A clean tap drops the sentinel into standby and opens the lane.
p2.a7.encounter.b1.opt3.label: Sprint straight down the centre flags before the chime
p2.a7.encounter.b1.opt3.outcome: The acoustic pulse catches your stride and knocks your timing off.
p2.a7.encounter.b1.rec.prompt: Your pulse spikes against the low wall as the sentinel resets its arc.
p2.a7.encounter.b1.rec.action: Drop into a three-count recovery breath and step through the next leeward gap
p2.a7.encounter.b1.rec.outcome: You steady your footing and pass the first narrows without further loss.
p2.a7.encounter.b2.prompt: Twin sentinels guard the wind-gap bridge ahead of the ridge shelter.
p2.a7.encounter.b2.clue1: Their chimes alternate by half a beat, leaving the low curb clear on odd counts.
p2.a7.encounter.b2.clue2: Parrying the near sentinel's baton interrupts the pair's linked barrier.
p2.a7.encounter.b2.opt1.label: Vault the low curb on the odd chime count
p2.a7.encounter.b2.opt1.outcome: You glide across the wind-gap in one smooth cadence.
p2.a7.encounter.b2.opt2.label: Parry the near baton and unseat the linked core
p2.a7.encounter.b2.opt2.outcome: The barrier folds cleanly and you cross to the shelter steps.
p2.a7.encounter.b2.opt3.label: Force the middle gap between both sweeps at once
p2.a7.encounter.b2.opt3.outcome: Crossed pulses pin you against the bridge rail.
p2.a7.encounter.b2.rec.prompt: Wind buffet and twin chimes hem you against the stone bollard.
p2.a7.encounter.b2.rec.action: Anchor behind the bollard, count two full cycles, and roll under the outer arc
p2.a7.encounter.b2.rec.outcome: You recover your rhythm and reach the shelter platform intact.
p2.a7.encounter.b3.prompt: At the shelter threshold, a winded candidate from the adjacent lane struggles toward the closing shutter.
p2.a7.encounter.b3.clue1: The shutter counterweight lever can be held for ninety seconds without tripping the lock.
p2.a7.encounter.b3.clue2: Calling out the odd-chime count lets a tired runner cross without guessing.
p2.a7.encounter.b3.opt1.label: Brace the counterweight lever and call the odd-chime count aloud
p2.a7.encounter.b3.opt1.outcome: Both of you clear the threshold safely with time to spare.
p2.a7.encounter.b3.opt2.label: Wave from inside the doorway while leaving the shutter on auto-timer
p2.a7.encounter.b3.opt2.outcome: The other runner makes it through, though with a bruised shoulder at the sill.
p2.a7.encounter.b3.opt3.label: Release the shutter latch immediately to lock your own clock
p2.a7.encounter.b3.opt3.outcome: The proctor board flags a premature seal while the lane is still occupied.
p2.a7.encounter.b3.rec.prompt: The shutter warning lamp flashes amber as the other runner reaches the curb.
p2.a7.encounter.b3.rec.action: Re-engage the manual hold pin and guide the runner across the sill
p2.a7.encounter.b3.rec.outcome: The door settles cleanly after both examinees are inside.
p2.a7.pace.title: Floor 1 · Monsoon Basalt Causeway
p2.a7.pace.setup: A three-kilometre stepped causeway loses surface friction as virtual mist thickens every four minutes.
p2.a7.pace.b1.prompt: Water films over the first kilometre of basalt steps as the mist cycle begins.
p2.a7.pace.b1.clue1: Chiselled drainage runnels along the inner edge stay grit-dry even under spray.
p2.a7.pace.b1.clue2: A 160-step-per-minute short stride prevents heel slip on wet stone.
p2.a7.pace.b1.opt1.label: Hold a short 160-cadence stride along the inner drainage runnels
p2.a7.pace.b1.opt1.outcome: Your shoes grip cleanly and your heart rate stays in the green zone.
p2.a7.pace.b1.opt2.label: Take the wide outer detour planks around the wettest risers
p2.a7.pace.b1.opt2.outcome: You avoid slipping but spend extra minutes on the longer loop.
p2.a7.pace.b1.opt3.label: Lengthen your stride across the polished centre slabs
p2.a7.pace.b1.opt3.outcome: Your heel skids on wet lichen and forces a hard stumble.
p2.a7.pace.b1.rec.prompt: Your calf tightens after the skid on the wet centre tier.
p2.a7.pace.b1.rec.action: Flex the ankle on the dry curb, shorten stride, and rejoin the inner runnel
p2.a7.pace.b1.rec.outcome: The cramp eases and you regain steady causeway pace.
p2.a7.pace.b2.prompt: In the second kilometre, cross-ridge gusts drive mist across the upper causeway tier.
p2.a7.pace.b2.clue1: The lower leeward tier sits below the wind-shear line with half the drag.
p2.a7.pace.b2.clue2: Four-step nasal breathing keeps core effort steady against the incline.
p2.a7.pace.b2.opt1.label: Drop to the leeward tier and lock into four-step breathing
p2.a7.pace.b2.opt1.outcome: You cut wind resistance in half and climb without lactate buildup.
p2.a7.pace.b2.opt2.label: Stay on the upper tier and crouch through each gust
p2.a7.pace.b2.opt2.outcome: You hold the line, though repeated crouches slow your split.
p2.a7.pace.b2.opt3.label: Sprint into the headwind to clear the crest in one burst
p2.a7.pace.b2.opt3.outcome: Your breathing raggedly redlines halfway up the ramp.
p2.a7.pace.b2.rec.prompt: Heavy breathing blurs your focus at the mid-ramp alcove.
p2.a7.pace.b2.rec.action: Step into the leeward alcove for sixty seconds of paced exhale before resuming
p2.a7.pace.b2.rec.outcome: Your pulse settles and you finish the second kilometre under control.
p2.a7.pace.b3.prompt: At the two-kilometre waypost, chalk markers have washed thin and another runner checks an empty flask.
p2.a7.pace.b3.clue1: Fresh wax-chalk arrows on the runnel lip survive three mist cycles.
p2.a7.pace.b3.clue2: Your pack holds two sealed electrolyte sachets beyond your own need.
p2.a7.pace.b3.opt1.label: Refresh the wax-chalk arrows and leave a spare electrolyte sachet on the bench
p2.a7.pace.b3.opt1.outcome: The trail remains legible for the whole cohort and both runners finish strong.
p2.a7.pace.b3.opt2.label: Call out which slabs are slick as you pass the waypost
p2.a7.pace.b3.opt2.outcome: The nearby runner hears your warning, though later arrivals must read the stone themselves.
p2.a7.pace.b3.opt3.label: Hurtle past the waypost without checking the washed-out markers
p2.a7.pace.b3.opt3.outcome: You miss the dry switchback turn and hit a slick cul-de-sac.
p2.a7.pace.b3.rec.prompt: The cul-de-sac rail blocks your path thirty metres above the waypost.
p2.a7.pace.b3.rec.action: Backtrack to the waypost, mark the dry switchback clearly, and take the true stair
p2.a7.pace.b3.rec.outcome: You reach the upper shelter with the route properly flagged.
p2.a7.team_transit.title: Floor 1 · Shale Valley Relay Transit
p2.a7.team_transit.setup: Move a three-student party and a sensitive barometer across shifting shale to the ridge shelter.
p2.a7.team_transit.b1.prompt: Loose shale slides underfoot while your teammate carrying the barometer favours a cramping calf.
p2.a7.team_transit.b1.clue1: The grey bedrock rib three metres north holds firm under group weight.
p2.a7.team_transit.b1.clue2: Shifting the barometer case to the centre pack evens everyone's load.
p2.a7.team_transit.b1.opt1.label: Move the barometer to the centre pack and lead along the bedrock rib
p2.a7.team_transit.b1.opt1.outcome: The party keeps a tight, even pace with zero instrument jar.
p2.a7.team_transit.b1.opt2.label: Walk single-file up the shale trough without repacking
p2.a7.team_transit.b1.opt2.outcome: You make steady progress, though the cramping teammate lags behind.
p2.a7.team_transit.b1.opt3.label: Call a fast double-time march straight up the loose scree
p2.a7.team_transit.b1.opt3.outcome: A shale slide twists your teammate's ankle and rattles the case.
p2.a7.team_transit.b1.rec.prompt: The team halts on the scree shelf as the barometer latch buzzes.
p2.a7.team_transit.b1.rec.action: Strap the ankle, re-seat the barometer foam, and traverse to the bedrock rib
p2.a7.team_transit.b1.rec.outcome: The party regains solid ground and resumes an even climb.
p2.a7.team_transit.b2.prompt: Cold valley wind pulses every six minutes as the cramping teammate needs water and calf relief.
p2.a7.team_transit.b2.clue1: A dry stone windbreak sits just before the mid-valley wind-pulse line.
p2.a7.team_transit.b2.clue2: Three minutes of elevated calf stretch and salted water prevents a full spasm.
p2.a7.team_transit.b2.opt1.label: Take a timed three-minute care stop behind the stone windbreak before the gust
p2.a7.team_transit.b2.opt1.outcome: The gust passes overhead while your teammate recovers full stride.
p2.a7.team_transit.b2.opt2.label: Pause standing in the open lane for a quick thirty-second sip
p2.a7.team_transit.b2.opt2.outcome: The team stays moving, though wind chill stiffens the muscle.
p2.a7.team_transit.b2.opt3.label: Skip the rest stop and push into the wind-pulse corridor
p2.a7.team_transit.b2.opt3.outcome: A full calf spasm forces an unplanned halt in the exposed wind.
p2.a7.team_transit.b2.rec.prompt: Wind buffets the party while your teammate kneels on the cold stone.
p2.a7.team_transit.b2.rec.action: Form a two-person wind screen, stretch the calf, and move to the lee wall
p2.a7.team_transit.b2.rec.outcome: Warmth returns to the leg and the group advances together.
p2.a7.team_transit.b3.prompt: A narrow rope-handrail ramp leads to the shelter door above a two-metre drop.
p2.a7.team_transit.b3.clue1: Clipping a waist loop to the guide rope lets the slowest walker cross hands-free.
p2.a7.team_transit.b3.clue2: Passing the barometer across on a taut haul line prevents any swing.
p2.a7.team_transit.b3.opt1.label: Belay the injured teammate across first, then haul the barometer on the guide line
p2.a7.team_transit.b3.opt1.outcome: Every team member and the calibrated barometer arrive in top condition.
p2.a7.team_transit.b3.opt2.label: Carry the barometer across yourself first and return for your teammate
p2.a7.team_transit.b3.opt2.outcome: Everyone reaches shelter safely, though the double crossing costs extra effort.
p2.a7.team_transit.b3.opt3.label: Have all three scramble up the ramp simultaneously without clips
p2.a7.team_transit.b3.opt3.outcome: Crowding on the narrow ramp knocks the barometer case against the rail.
p2.a7.team_transit.b3.rec.prompt: The party jams mid-ramp as the guide rope oscillates.
p2.a7.team_transit.b3.rec.action: Hold position, clip the waist loops in order, and space the crossing by three paces
p2.a7.team_transit.b3.rec.outcome: The ramp steadies and all three step into the shelter together.
p2.a7.changed_rule.title: Floor 2 · Inverted-Head Cistern Lab
p2.a7.changed_rule.setup: A Class XI stock-and-flow water tank bench operates under one changed physical law that you must deduce and test.
p2.a7.changed_rule.changed_rule: Siphon-Head Inversion: drain outflow increases with empty headspace above the waterline rather than water depth below it.
p2.a7.changed_rule.b1.prompt: With inflow closed, the cistern level drops slowly when full at 80 L but drains twice as fast as it approaches 40 L.
p2.a7.changed_rule.b1.clue1: Stopwatch readings show outflow Q_out = 0.25 * (100 - V) L/min, proportional to empty headspace.
p2.a7.changed_rule.b1.clue2: The siphon regulator on the roof vents pressure in inverse proportion to water height.
p2.a7.changed_rule.b1.opt1.label: Formulate the headspace law Q_out = 0.25 * (100 - V) from the two timed intervals
p2.a7.changed_rule.b1.opt1.outcome: Your linear headspace equation matches every gauge tick to the tenth of a litre.
p2.a7.changed_rule.b1.opt2.label: Run three extra drain trials to chart the curve empirically
p2.a7.changed_rule.b1.opt2.outcome: You confirm the inverted trend by table, using a few extra minutes.
p2.a7.changed_rule.b1.opt3.label: Apply the textbook depth law and set the drain coefficient for high water
p2.a7.changed_rule.b1.opt3.outcome: Your prediction diverges sharply as the cistern accelerates downward.
p2.a7.changed_rule.b1.rec.prompt: The sight-glass drops past 50 L faster than your textbook curve predicted.
p2.a7.changed_rule.b1.rec.action: Close the test tap, compare ΔV against empty headspace (100 - V), and revise the slope
p2.a7.changed_rule.b1.rec.outcome: The corrected headspace formula locks onto the live sight-glass readings.
p2.a7.changed_rule.b2.prompt: The proctor lock requires holding the cistern steady at exactly 60 L for four minutes.
p2.a7.changed_rule.b2.clue1: At V = 60 L, empty headspace is 40 L, so drain outflow is exactly 0.25 * 40 = 10 L/min.
p2.a7.changed_rule.b2.clue2: Setting inflow Q_in = 10 L/min after pre-filling to 60 L creates an exact dynamic balance.
p2.a7.changed_rule.b2.opt1.label: Bring the tank to 60 L and lock the inflow dial at 10.0 L/min
p2.a7.changed_rule.b2.opt1.outcome: The meniscus holds dead-level on the 60 L scribe line for all four minutes.
p2.a7.changed_rule.b2.opt2.label: Trim the inflow valve by hand every thirty seconds while watching the glass
p2.a7.changed_rule.b2.opt2.outcome: You keep the level within tolerance, though with small manual oscillations.
p2.a7.changed_rule.b2.opt3.label: Set inflow to 15 L/min assuming drain outflow will rise to meet it
p2.a7.changed_rule.b2.opt3.outcome: Rising water shrinks headspace, slows the drain further, and threatens an overflow.
p2.a7.changed_rule.b2.rec.prompt: The meniscus climbs past 68 L as drain outflow drops under shrinking headspace.
p2.a7.changed_rule.b2.rec.action: Pulse the relief drain back to 60 L and set inflow to the 10.0 L/min equilibrium mark
p2.a7.changed_rule.b2.rec.outcome: The cistern settles on the 60 L mark and completes the verification window.
p2.a7.changed_rule.b3.prompt: A second examination pair arrives at the shared manifold console as your verification bell rings.
p2.a7.changed_rule.b3.clue1: Writing the headspace conversion table on the console slate prevents runaway overflow errors.
p2.a7.changed_rule.b3.clue2: Returning the tank to neutral 50 L leaves safe margin in both directions.
p2.a7.changed_rule.b3.opt1.label: Reset the cistern to 50 L and post the headspace-to-outflow table on the slate
p2.a7.changed_rule.b3.opt1.outcome: The incoming pair reads the changed rule clearly and starts from a safe baseline.
p2.a7.changed_rule.b3.opt2.label: Leave your raw notebook scratchings beside the valve wheel
p2.a7.changed_rule.b3.opt2.outcome: The notes are accurate, though the next pair takes a moment to decipher them.
p2.a7.changed_rule.b3.opt3.label: Wipe the console slate blank and leave the inlet valve half-open
p2.a7.changed_rule.b3.opt3.outcome: The manifold buzzer warns of an unlogged live flow state.
p2.a7.changed_rule.b3.rec.prompt: The manifold check-lamp blinks as the cistern drifts away from neutral.
p2.a7.changed_rule.b3.rec.action: Zero the inlet valve, stabilise at 50 L, and chalk the headspace equation on the board
p2.a7.changed_rule.b3.rec.outcome: The bench passes handoff inspection cleanly.
p2.a7.stabilise.title: Floor 2 · Thermal-Inversion Reserve Board
p2.a7.stabilise.setup: Diagnose and repair a Class XI DC series-parallel bio-filter board without exhausting its 30% reserve cell floor.
p2.a7.stabilise.changed_rule: Current-Draw Thermal Inversion: branch resistance drops linearly with sustained current (R_eff = R_0 - alpha * I), causing parallel current hogging.
p2.a7.stabilise.b1.prompt: Branch A of the parallel bio-filter pump is drawing 9 A and rising, while Branch B starves at 1 A and reserve charge falls.
p2.a7.stabilise.b1.clue1: Clamp-meter readings show Branch A's resistance falling from 6 Ohm to 3 Ohm as current warms the coil.
p2.a7.stabilise.b1.clue2: In a parallel pair under this inverted rule, the warmer branch hogs current unless ballasted in series.
p2.a7.stabilise.b1.opt1.label: Measure both branches with the clamp meter to confirm negative current-resistance slope
p2.a7.stabilise.b1.opt1.outcome: You pinpoint the exact thermal-inversion coefficient while reserve cells stay at 62%.
p2.a7.stabilise.b1.opt2.label: Toggle each branch switch alternately to watch the voltmeter
p2.a7.stabilise.b1.opt2.outcome: You identify the hogging branch, spending a bit more reserve charge.
p2.a7.stabilise.b1.opt3.label: Clip a low-ohm copper shunt directly in parallel with Branch A
p2.a7.stabilise.b1.opt3.outcome: Total current spikes and trips the reserve-cell low-voltage alarm.
p2.a7.stabilise.b1.rec.prompt: The reserve indicator flashes at 44% as the shunt draws surge current.
p2.a7.stabilise.b1.rec.action: Pull the parallel shunt, open the main knife switch for ten seconds, and log the branch resistance
p2.a7.stabilise.b1.rec.outcome: The coil cools to baseline and reserve voltage recovers above 55%.
p2.a7.stabilise.b2.prompt: You must restore balanced 4 A flow to both bio-filter pumps while keeping reserve cells above 50%.
p2.a7.stabilise.b2.clue1: Adding a 2 Ohm positive-coefficient ballast resistor in series with each branch cancels the negative slope.
p2.a7.stabilise.b2.clue2: Balanced 4 A branches run the bio-filter at full efficiency within the solar trickle recharge rate.
p2.a7.stabilise.b2.opt1.label: Wire matching 2 Ohm series ballast blocks into both parallel legs
p2.a7.stabilise.b2.opt1.outcome: Both ammeters lock onto 4.0 A and reserve charge steadies at 58%.
p2.a7.stabilise.b2.opt2.label: Pulse-throttle Branch A by hand with the rotary rheostat
p2.a7.stabilise.b2.opt2.outcome: The bio-filter stabilises, though manual trimming takes extra minutes.
p2.a7.stabilise.b2.opt3.label: Bridge the current-limiter fuse to force Branch B up to speed
p2.a7.stabilise.b2.opt3.outcome: Branch A surges again and drags the reserve bus toward the trip line.
p2.a7.stabilise.b2.rec.prompt: The thermal buzzer sounds as Branch A climbs past 8 A.
p2.a7.stabilise.b2.rec.action: Re-insert the limiter fuse and slot the 2 Ohm series ballast into both legs
p2.a7.stabilise.b2.rec.outcome: Current splits evenly at 4.0 A per leg with safe reserve margin.
p2.a7.stabilise.b3.prompt: With the bio-filter stabilised, the switching bay must be secured for the next maintenance crew.
p2.a7.stabilise.b3.clue1: Fitting the acrylic busbar guard prevents accidental tool contact with the ballast terminals.
p2.a7.stabilise.b3.clue2: A clear circuit tag noting the 2 Ohm series ballast stops future crews from removing it.
p2.a7.stabilise.b3.opt1.label: Fit the busbar guard, verify zero stray voltage, and attach the ballast circuit tag
p2.a7.stabilise.b3.opt1.outcome: The bay is touch-safe and clearly documented for every subsequent shift.
p2.a7.stabilise.b3.opt2.label: Latch the cabinet door shut without tagging the new series blocks
p2.a7.stabilise.b3.opt2.outcome: The cabinet is enclosed, though the next crew will have to trace the wiring.
p2.a7.stabilise.b3.opt3.label: Leave the jumper leads dangling across the open terminal strip
p2.a7.stabilise.b3.opt3.outcome: The panel interlock refuses green status while live leads are exposed.
p2.a7.stabilise.b3.rec.prompt: The bay interlock lamp stays amber due to unguarded test leads.
p2.a7.stabilise.b3.rec.action: Stow the test leads, snap the acrylic guard in place, and clip the circuit tag to the door
p2.a7.stabilise.b3.rec.outcome: The interlock turns green and the bay handoff is complete.
p2.a7.design.title: Floor 2 · Anti-Phase Harmonic Span
p2.a7.design.setup: Build and test a stable walkway damper using a Class XI spring-mass system with one changed coupling rule.
p2.a7.design.changed_rule: In-Phase Stiffening Lock: spring stiffness k doubles whenever adjacent frames move in phase, and stays calm at k_0 only in 180-degree anti-phase.
p2.a7.design.b1.prompt: Four suspended walkway frames shudder sharply whenever a runner steps across them in unison.
p2.a7.design.b1.clue1: Stroboscope ticks show period T dropping by 1 / sqrt(2) whenever two frames swing together in phase.
p2.a7.design.b1.clue2: Coupling adjacent frames through a central pivot rocker forces 180-degree anti-phase motion and restores baseline k_0.
p2.a7.design.b1.opt1.label: Test an anti-phase pair on the bench rig to confirm baseline k_0 restoration
p2.a7.design.b1.opt1.outcome: The paired frames glide smoothly with zero harmonic spike.
p2.a7.design.b1.opt2.label: Weigh and time each hanger individually before coupling them
p2.a7.design.b1.opt2.outcome: You gather complete mass data, spending an extra minute at the bench.
p2.a7.design.b1.opt3.label: Bolt all four frames rigidly in phase to share the load
p2.a7.design.b1.opt3.outcome: Stiffness doubles across the span and sends a sharp jolt through the deck.
p2.a7.design.b1.rec.prompt: The rigid bar vibrates loudly on the test stand.
p2.a7.design.b1.rec.action: Unbolt the rigid tie, mount the centre pivot pin, and verify opposite-phase travel
p2.a7.design.b1.rec.outcome: The test pair settles into a quiet anti-phase oscillation.
p2.a7.design.b2.prompt: Now assemble the full four-frame walkway arrangement and test it under a 60 kg rolling cart.
p2.a7.design.b2.clue1: Linking Frames 1-2 and 3-4 with alternating rocker arms keeps every neighbour 180 degrees out of phase.
p2.a7.design.b2.clue2: Equal 5 kg counterweights at the rocker ends keep deck height level under moving load.
p2.a7.design.b2.opt1.label: Install alternating rocker links between Frames 1-2 and 3-4 with balanced end weights
p2.a7.design.b2.opt1.outcome: The 60 kg test cart rolls across with less than 2 mm of vertical ripple.
p2.a7.design.b2.opt2.label: Preload the end springs heavily and link only the middle pair
p2.a7.design.b2.opt2.outcome: The span passes the cart test with moderate bounce at the ends.
p2.a7.design.b2.opt3.label: Stack all counterweights on the centre frame without rocker links
p2.a7.design.b2.opt3.outcome: Neighbouring frames lock in phase under the cart and trip the vibration gauge.
p2.a7.design.b2.rec.prompt: The vibration needle touches red as the cart reaches Frame 2.
p2.a7.design.b2.rec.action: Redistribute the 5 kg weights to the rocker arms and pin the alternating links
p2.a7.design.b2.rec.outcome: The second cart pass stays well inside the green damping band.
p2.a7.design.b3.prompt: Other candidates without physics kits will cross this span during the final ten minutes of the floor.
p2.a7.design.b3.clue1: High-contrast ribbed floor strips at the rocker nodes show exactly where to plant each foot.
p2.a7.design.b3.clue2: A two-tone chime pendulum at the entry rail gives an audible anti-phase beat.
p2.a7.design.b3.opt1.label: Fix ribbed node strips to the deck and set the entry chime pendulum to the safe cadence
p2.a7.design.b3.opt1.outcome: Any walker—by sight, touch, or sound—can cross the span smoothly.
p2.a7.design.b3.opt2.label: Chalk small tick marks along the side rail
p2.a7.design.b3.opt2.outcome: Careful observers spot the marks, though hurried runners have to look down.
p2.a7.design.b3.opt3.label: Pull your alignment pins and pack the guide strips away
p2.a7.design.b3.opt3.outcome: The proctor monitor notes that the walkway lacks public safety markings.
p2.a7.design.b3.rec.prompt: An approaching examinee hesitates at the unmarked deck threshold.
p2.a7.design.b3.rec.action: Lay down the tactile node strips and lock the alignment pins in place
p2.a7.design.b3.rec.outcome: The crossing guide is clear and the span is certified for open use.
p2.a7.alliance.title: Floor 3 · Central Relay Amplifier Compact
p2.a7.alliance.setup: Three examination squads need the same two high-capacity signal amplifiers before the 45-minute bell.
p2.a7.alliance.b1.prompt: Squad North and Squad West both demand Amplifier 1 immediately, while Squad South waits with a half-charged array.
p2.a7.alliance.b1.clue1: Squad North's beacon only needs 40% wattage for eight minutes during its orbital window.
p2.a7.alliance.b1.clue2: Squad West needs high wattage only after twelve minutes of antenna alignment.
p2.a7.alliance.b1.opt1.label: Ask each squad lead to show their actual window clock and minimum wattage on the table
p2.a7.alliance.b1.opt1.outcome: The overlapping demands dissolve into three non-conflicting eight-minute windows.
p2.a7.alliance.b1.opt2.label: Propose splitting the remaining time into equal ten-minute blocks by lottery
p2.a7.alliance.b1.opt2.outcome: The squads accept the truce, though the lottery order is less efficient.
p2.a7.alliance.b1.opt3.label: Award both amplifiers to the loudest squad first without checking schedules
p2.a7.alliance.b1.opt3.outcome: The other two squads dead-lock the relay switchboard in protest.
p2.a7.alliance.b1.rec.prompt: Voices rise around the switchboard as two leads reach for the master breaker.
p2.a7.alliance.b1.rec.action: Place the neutral timer slate between them and log each squad's true window clock
p2.a7.alliance.b1.rec.outcome: Both leads step back and agree to work from the verified window chart.
p2.a7.alliance.b2.prompt: You need a binding handoff schedule so no squad holds an amplifier past its window.
p2.a7.alliance.b2.clue1: A dual-plug transfer block lets the next squad pre-wire while the current transmission finishes.
p2.a7.alliance.b2.clue2: Posting the three-phase timetable on the overhead board makes every handoff public.
p2.a7.alliance.b2.opt1.label: Draft a staggered two-amplifier compact using the dual-plug block and public timer board
p2.a7.alliance.b2.opt1.outcome: All three squads sign the board and transitions take less than fifteen seconds.
p2.a7.alliance.b2.opt2.label: Arrange a one-to-one swap between North and West first, leaving South for last
p2.a7.alliance.b2.opt2.outcome: The swap works, though Squad South has a tighter final margin.
p2.a7.alliance.b2.opt3.label: Rely on an unrecorded verbal promise to hand over the cables on time
p2.a7.alliance.b2.opt3.outcome: A disputed two-minute overrun threatens the third transmission slot.
p2.a7.alliance.b2.rec.prompt: Squad North's operator hesitates to unplug at the eight-minute mark.
p2.a7.alliance.b2.rec.action: Engage the pre-wired transfer switch and point to the co-signed countdown clock
p2.a7.alliance.b2.rec.outcome: The handoff completes cleanly within the grace window.
p2.a7.alliance.b3.prompt: Squad South has only two members and a heavier cable reel as their final window opens.
p2.a7.alliance.b3.clue1: Helping haul their feeder cable saves three minutes and protects the shared relay fuse.
p2.a7.alliance.b3.clue2: Co-signing the completion ledger credits all three squads' joint coordination.
p2.a7.alliance.b3.opt1.label: Keep one volunteer from each early squad to help seat South's cable and co-sign the ledger
p2.a7.alliance.b3.opt1.outcome: All three squads clear Floor 3 with full relay verification and zero fuse trips.
p2.a7.alliance.b3.opt2.label: Leave the amplifier ready on the bench and sign your own squad's line
p2.a7.alliance.b3.opt2.outcome: Squad South finishes just before the bell after hauling the reel alone.
p2.a7.alliance.b3.opt3.label: Power down the shared bus as soon as your own signal clears
p2.a7.alliance.b3.opt3.outcome: Cutting the bus mid-handoff triggers a floor coordination alert.
p2.a7.alliance.b3.rec.prompt: Squad South's console flickers as the main bus drops toward standby.
p2.a7.alliance.b3.rec.action: Restore bus power, assist with the heavy coupler, and complete the three-way sign-off
p2.a7.alliance.b3.rec.outcome: The final signal locks in and all three squads pass together.
p2.a7.supply.title: Floor 3 · Upper-Ring Filtration Supply
p2.a7.supply.setup: Route twelve crates of filtration cartridges and thermal packs across three stations after the central hoist jams.
p2.a7.supply.b1.prompt: East Station has 11 minutes of filter life left, North has 22 minutes, and West has 30 minutes.
p2.a7.supply.b1.clue1: The dry east stair can carry four priority crates to East Station in six minutes.
p2.a7.supply.b1.clue2: The central hoist brake is locked until its counterweight pin is reset from above.
p2.a7.supply.b1.opt1.label: Dispatch four crates up the east stair to East Station first while staging North's load
p2.a7.supply.b1.opt1.outcome: East Station swaps cartridges with five minutes of clean margin remaining.
p2.a7.supply.b1.opt2.label: Divide crates into three equal piles and carry them one station at a time by distance
p2.a7.supply.b1.opt2.outcome: Every station receives stock, though East Station briefly dips into reserve.
p2.a7.supply.b1.opt3.label: Stack all twelve crates on the jammed central hoist and wait for it to clear
p2.a7.supply.b1.opt3.outcome: Four minutes slip away while East Station's filter warning chimes.
p2.a7.supply.b1.rec.prompt: East Station's amber lamp blinks with seven minutes left on its filter clock.
p2.a7.supply.b1.rec.action: Unstack two priority crates onto shoulder frames and run them up the east stair
p2.a7.supply.b1.rec.outcome: East Station's filters are replaced before the reserve line is breached.
p2.a7.supply.b2.prompt: A simulated masonry slide blocks the mid-ring bridge while eight crates still need to reach North and West.
p2.a7.supply.b2.clue1: The auxiliary hand-winch lifts two crates per cycle straight to North Station's balcony.
p2.a7.supply.b2.clue2: The covered south walkway bypasses the slide and reaches West Station in five minutes.
p2.a7.supply.b2.opt1.label: Split the convoy: send four crates up the North hand-winch and wheel four along the south walkway
p2.a7.supply.b2.opt1.outcome: Both North and West receive their full allocation ahead of schedule.
p2.a7.supply.b2.opt2.label: Haul all eight crates single-file around the long south walkway
p2.a7.supply.b2.opt2.outcome: The full load arrives intact, though the longer loop costs extra minutes.
p2.a7.supply.b2.opt3.label: Try to lever the masonry slide blocks aside by hand
p2.a7.supply.b2.opt3.outcome: The heavy virtual blocks stay locked and the delivery clock tightens.
p2.a7.supply.b2.rec.prompt: North Station calls for cartridges as the bridge remains impassable.
p2.a7.supply.b2.rec.action: Hook the cargo net to the North balcony hand-winch and divert the cart south
p2.a7.supply.b2.rec.outcome: Both stations acknowledge receipt with reserve air intact.
p2.a7.supply.b3.prompt: Two reserve crates remain after all three stations are at 100% capacity.
p2.a7.supply.b3.clue1: The central junction locker is equidistant from all three stations for late-exam surges.
p2.a7.supply.b3.clue2: A signed manifest card on the locker door shows exact cartridge serials and expiry times.
p2.a7.supply.b3.opt1.label: Store the two buffer crates in the central junction locker and post the signed manifest
p2.a7.supply.b3.opt1.outcome: Any station facing a late surge can draw verified stock in under two minutes.
p2.a7.supply.b3.opt2.label: Leave both extra crates stacked beside West Station's door
p2.a7.supply.b3.opt2.outcome: The crates are safe, though East Station would face a long haul to reach them.
p2.a7.supply.b3.opt3.label: Leave the spare crates unlabelled on the open landing
p2.a7.supply.b3.opt3.outcome: The logistics board flags an unindexed reserve cache.
p2.a7.supply.b3.rec.prompt: The proctor terminal requests a manifest location for the two spare crates.
p2.a7.supply.b3.rec.action: Move the crates into the junction locker and log their serials on the door slate
p2.a7.supply.b3.rec.outcome: The ring manifest balances at 12/12 crates accounted for.
p2.a7.mediation.title: Floor 3 · Relay Air-Valve Mediation
p2.a7.mediation.setup: Resolve a deadlock between two exhausted student specialists after a mistimed valve release cost six minutes of reserve air.
p2.a7.mediation.b1.prompt: Specialist Rao and Specialist Sen each insist the other misread the manifold pressure callout.
p2.a7.mediation.b1.clue1: The paper pressure strip shows the acoustic bell rang at the exact moment the verbal call was made.
p2.a7.mediation.b1.clue2: Both operators have been on station for forty minutes without a water break.
p2.a7.mediation.b1.opt1.label: Lay the paper pressure strip on the desk to show the bell masked the verbal callout
p2.a7.mediation.b1.opt1.outcome: Both specialists see the mechanical overlap immediately and drop the personal blame.
p2.a7.mediation.b1.opt2.label: Ask both operators to sit in opposite corners for two minutes of quiet breathing
p2.a7.mediation.b1.opt2.outcome: Tempers cool, though the root communication gap still needs addressing.
p2.a7.mediation.b1.opt3.label: Declare one specialist at fault so the room can restart faster
p2.a7.mediation.b1.opt3.outcome: The accused operator withdraws consent and the dual-key console stays locked.
p2.a7.mediation.b1.rec.prompt: The dual-key console remains dark while one operator refuses to sign in.
p2.a7.mediation.b1.rec.action: Withdraw the fault claim, point to the bell spike on the strip chart, and invite both back
p2.a7.mediation.b1.rec.outcome: Both specialists place their keys in the console slots.
p2.a7.mediation.b2.prompt: The final pressurisation cycle requires turning the intake and bleed valves within two seconds of each other.
p2.a7.mediation.b2.clue1: A visual hand-signal plus read-back checklist cannot be drowned out by the acoustic bell.
p2.a7.mediation.b2.clue2: Both operators must confirm readiness before either valve wheel is unlocked.
p2.a7.mediation.b2.opt1.label: Institute a two-step visual hand-signal and read-back checklist with explicit consent
p2.a7.mediation.b2.opt1.outcome: Both wheels turn within 0.4 seconds and manifold pressure climbs smoothly to 100 kPa.
p2.a7.mediation.b2.opt2.label: Relay the countdown yourself while standing between the two valves
p2.a7.mediation.b2.opt2.outcome: The valves turn together, though the operators depend on your middle call.
p2.a7.mediation.b2.opt3.label: Unlock the intake wheel unilaterally and tell the bleed operator to catch up
p2.a7.mediation.b2.opt3.outcome: Pressure surges against the closed bleed valve and trips the relief whistle.
p2.a7.mediation.b2.rec.prompt: The relief whistle shrills as pressure imbalances across the chamber.
p2.a7.mediation.b2.rec.action: Close intake to neutral, agree on the three-finger visual cue, and run the synced turn
p2.a7.mediation.b2.rec.outcome: The chamber pressurises evenly on the synchronised turn.
p2.a7.mediation.b3.prompt: Ten minutes of monitoring remain and Specialist Sen's hands are trembling from forty minutes on the heavy wheel.
p2.a7.mediation.b3.clue1: Rotating Sen to the seated gauge desk and Rao to the wheel matches fresh strength to the task.
p2.a7.mediation.b3.clue2: A joint no-fault log note records the bell-masking fix for future room teams.
p2.a7.mediation.b3.opt1.label: Rotate stations by mutual agreement and co-sign a no-fault engineering note on the bell overlap
p2.a7.mediation.b3.opt1.outcome: The room finishes at 100% stability with both specialists rested and credited.
p2.a7.mediation.b3.opt2.label: Keep both specialists at their original posts with a five-minute check-in
p2.a7.mediation.b3.opt2.outcome: The cycle completes, though Sen finishes the shift exhausted.
p2.a7.mediation.b3.opt3.label: Log a disciplinary demerit against the room to close the ticket quickly
p2.a7.mediation.b3.opt3.outcome: The proctor board rejects an unconsented fault filing.
p2.a7.mediation.b3.rec.prompt: The room log terminal prompts for mutual sign-off before clearing Floor 3.
p2.a7.mediation.b3.rec.action: Cancel the fault entry, swap the fatigued post, and record the shared acoustic-bell fix
p2.a7.mediation.b3.rec.outcome: Both specialists counter-sign the log and the floor clears.
